# About This Manual {#sec-about}

This manual covers the supported review workstation and the hospital Model API deployment of Retinal Review Workbench 0.7.0. It is written for hospital IT, deployment operators, and maintainers. Clinical use of the workstation is described in the separate *Clinician User Manual*.

| Chapter | Covers |
|:--------|:-------|
| Architecture and supported scope | Topology, component roles, boundaries, data ownership |
| Installation | Review workstation, Linux server checkout, configuration |
| Model API setup and startup | One-time online setup, normal startup, health checks, offline behaviour |
| Routine operations | systemd service, workstation connection, daily readiness check |
| Security, privacy, backup, and restore | Data handling, secrets, backup scope, restore procedure, CVAT |
| Upgrade, rollback, and release acceptance | Controlled upgrade, rollback, troubleshooting, acceptance record |

: {tbl-colwidths="[36,64]"}

::: {.callout-warning title="Safety -- protected deployment"}
Keep the Model API on a protected hospital network. Do not expose it directly to the public internet. Apply hospital firewall, TLS, authentication, and secret-management policy at the deployment boundary.
:::
